{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "build",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Removes Boost.Test from build and packaging systems in cmake/module/AddBoostIfNeeded.cmake, depends/packages/boost.mk, vcpkg.json, and contrib/guix/libexec/build_linux.sh.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.35,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Dropping Boost.Test simplifies depends, Guix, and CMake configurations by eliminating external dependency maintenance overhead. The author notes that removing Boost.Test 'helps us simplify depends and guix' as well as improving toolchain integration."
    },
    {
      "name": "ipc",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Only touches src/ipc/test/ipc_tests.cpp via a mechanical include-header replacement.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Mechanical header adjustments following the unit test framework replacement do not constitute an IPC change."
    },
    {
      "name": "kernel",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Only touches src/test/kernel/test_kernel.cpp via a mechanical include-header replacement.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Mechanical header edits to kernel test files do not affect the kernel API, boundary, or library behavior."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Implements an in-tree test runner and framework in src/test/util/framework.{h,cpp} and updates the test harness in src/test/main.cpp.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Replacing Boost.Test resolves longstanding unit-test tooling friction and eliminates quirky library behaviors like undersized signal stacks. The author notes that expression decomposition provides automatic operand logging on failure, and reviewers emphasize that an in-house customizable runner removes barriers to writing tests and enables concurrency improvements in CI."
    },
    {
      "name": "tools",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "The only contrib path touched is contrib/guix/libexec/build_linux.sh, which belongs to build/Guix rather than developer tools.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Changes to Guix build scripts belong to build infrastructure, not standalone scripts or developer tools."
    },
    {
      "name": "wallet",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Only touches wallet unit test files via a scripted-diff include update.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Mechanical header replacements across wallet tests do not modify wallet behavior, interfaces, or wallet logic."
    }
  ],
  "factors": {
    "security_stability": 1,
    "bug_severity": 0,
    "performance": 1,
    "user_value": 0,
    "leverage": 2
  }
}
